selected.adaptation: Accepted promise-driven action adapted to Send my brief. Resolves only after server confirms saved answers and original uploads. Preview explicitly does not email.

unmatched.region: One question at a time, branching product mini-flow, native inputs and uploads
unmatched.gap: Approved tabs/sidebar/tour APIs serve panel navigation or modal demonstrations, not an editable branching interview. User explicitly rejected dashboard layout and requested Typeform-style flow. Native form controls and caller-owned flow/persistence used.

Approved Blob provides gaze and expression inspiration but is SVG. User requested actual 3D and then authorized mascot-only animation above questions. Original procedural Three.js character uses 30fps gentle sway, blink, and field-aware peeking. Reduced-motion, offscreen and hidden-tab pause included. Crown direction remains provisional.

Approved FluidTabs controls ARIA tab panels; SidebarRail provides route/drawer chrome; IntroDisclosure is modal onboarding. None models editable interview steps, visited-question return or paused product mini-flows. Native nav, ordered list and buttons implement those semantics without dashboard chrome.
unmatched.verification: Current aria-current step, unavailable future steps, current mobile scroll position, product editor resume, required-field validation before send and immutable accepted receipt.

design: One focused question per view; details optional; no sidebar, file tree, category overview, checklist or client-facing reference directory; reduced-motion alternative
storage: Per-invitation local IndexedDB retains original File bytes. Cloud uploads use a short-lived signed capability through the private Cloudflare Worker/R2 gateway; success requires a confirmed server receipt.
